manuals.title: Centrifugal Ball Governor Calibration & High-Pressure Steam Throttling
manuals.origin_facility: Kharkov Heavy Turbine Works (Ministry of Heavy Power)
manuals.schematic_summary: Flyball spring balance mechanism linked via rack-and-pinion to the high-pressure main steam throttle valve at 42 bar. Diagram shows oil dashpot damping orifice tolerances (0.05mm).
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: If the flyweight pivot pins wear by even a quarter millimeter, the turbine hunts between 2,800 and 3,400 RPM like a panicked horse. Keep the brass pivot bushings soaked in graphite grease.

manuals.title: Pneumatic Coanda-Effect Logic Elements (EMP-Immune Fluidic Computing)
manuals.schematic_summary: Wall-attachment fluidic NOR/NAND gates etched into ceramic plates. Uses 2.5 bar dry compressed air jets with no moving parts to execute automated blast-door interlock logic.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: The genius of this system: an electromagnetic pulse melts every silicon microchip in the valley, but air blowing through ceramic grooves keeps calculating logic forever. Just keep the air dried of oil droplets.

manuals.title: Steel-Tank Mercury Arc Rectifier Ignition & Vacuum Maintenance
manuals.schematic_summary: 6-phase water-cooled steel tank housing liquid mercury pool cathode and graphite anodes. Converts 6,000V AC to 600V DC for heavy electric mining locos. Explains manual mercury ignition dipping rod.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: The eerie blue-violet glow inside the observation port means 500 kilowatts of DC current are flowing. If the vacuum drops below 0.001 Torr, you get a backfire that will blow the ceramic anode bushings across the room.

manuals.title: Subterranean Geophone Piezoelectric Array Calibration & Strike Triangulation
manuals.origin_facility: State Institute of Geophysics & Deep Seismic Sounding
manuals.schematic_summary: Four-point orthogonal geophone array layout using moving-coil pickups embedded in solid granite. Wheatstone bridge circuit feeding galvanometric chart recorder to calculate seismic P-wave and S-wave epicenters.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Taras uses this schematic to calculate whether a tremor was an aftershock on the fault line or an underground collapse in Silo 0. The needle never lies, but the paper roll is almost gone.

manuals.title: Closed-Cycle Stirling Cryocooler Operation & Liquid Nitrogen Generation
manuals.schematic_summary: Two-piston rhombic drive Stirling engine charged with high-purity helium at 25 bar. Generates 77 Kelvin refrigeration at the cold head to liquefy atmospheric nitrogen and oxygen for medical cryo-storage.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Helium gas is irreplaceable down here. If the rod seals leak, we cannot recharge it. Check the copper gasket torque with the micro-wrench before every cryo run.

manuals.title: GU-81M Pentode 1kW Shortwave Radio Transmitter Output Stage
manuals.schematic_summary: Graphite-anode direct-heated transmitting pentode operating at 2,500V plate voltage. Pi-network tank circuit matching 50-ohm long-wire antenna for 3 to 30 MHz broadcast across the irradiated continent.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: That glass bottle runs hot enough to fry an egg on the ceramic socket. When Taras cranks the modulator to full power on 88.4 MHz, the fluorescent light tubes on the ceiling glow without wires.

manuals.title: Hydro-Pneumatic Piston Accumulator Overhaul & Blast Door Emergency Drive
manuals.schematic_summary: Seamless forged steel cylinder with free-floating chrome piston separating mineral oil at 210 bar from compressed nitrogen reserve. Supplies instantaneous hydraulic energy to seal 20-ton blast doors in 1.2 seconds.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Never, ever lubricate the gas side with mineral oil unless you want a diesel-explosion inside the cylinder wall. Nitrogen only. Clean the leather chevron seals in kerosene.

manuals.title: Stationary OPzS Lead-Acid Battery Desulfation & Electrolyte Rectification
manuals.origin_facility: Podolsk Battery Works (Bunker Emergency Power Division)
manuals.schematic_summary: 2V transparent glass cell bank maintenance. Instructions for specific gravity hydrometer testing (1.240 g/cm3), pulsed high-current desulfation cycling, and lead plate sediment flush procedures.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Wear your rubber apron and glass goggles. If you splash sulfuric acid on your boots, you won't notice until your leather soles fall off in the shower. Keep baking soda paste within arm's reach.

manuals.title: Cellulose Acetate Spiral-Wound Reverse Osmosis Desalination & Isotope Filter
manuals.origin_facility: All-Union Institute of Water Purification & Chemical Defense
manuals.schematic_summary: Multi-stage high-pressure permeate vessel operating at 55 bar. Cross-flow membrane filtration removing dissolved heavy metals, strontium-90, and cesium-137 ions with 98.6% rejection rate.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: The membranes are delicate as dragonfly wings. If chlorine from the municipal pipes touches them, they dissolve into mush in four hours. Always flush with activated charcoal pre-filters first.

manuals.title: STS-5 / SBM-20 Geiger-Müller Halogen Quenched Counter Tube Refurbishment
manuals.origin_facility: Special Instrument Design Bureau of the Atomic Ministry
manuals.schematic_summary: Thin-walled stainless steel cylinder cathode with central tungsten wire anode at 400V DC. Internal gas mix: 98% Neon, 1.5% Argon, 0.5% Bromine halogen quenching vapor. Glass-to-metal seal pinout.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Without working Geiger tubes, we are blind men walking in a burning forest. If a tube develops micro-cracks, vacuum it down and refill from the lecture bottle of neon-bromine gas. Seal with shellac wax.

manuals.title: Positive Displacement Twin-Lobe Roots Blower Timing Gear Alignment
manuals.schematic_summary: Two figure-eight cast iron lobes rotating in counter-direction without contact. Backlash timing gears lubricated by oil bath. Supplies 1,200 m3/hr positive bunker overpressure through sand pre-filters.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: The clearance between the spinning lobes is exactly 0.12mm. If a single pebble from the intake duct gets sucked past the mesh, the lobes jam and strip the timing gears in one violent bang.

manuals.title: Theo-010 Precision Optical Micrometer Underground Tunnel Surveying
manuals.origin_facility: Carl Zeiss Jena / Optical Instrument Trust
manuals.schematic_summary: Direct reading optical micrometer with 1-arc-second accuracy. Inverted prism optics with illumination mirrors for plumb-line optical transfer down deep vertical elevator shafts.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: When excavating the escape drift toward the old railway tunnel, this theodolite kept us from drifting into the subterranean karst cavern. Never wipe the lenses with anything coarser than silk.

manuals.title: Synchronous Rotary Spark Gap High-Voltage Surge Discharger & Line Decoupling
manuals.schematic_summary: Motor-driven spinning tungsten disc with eight radial electrodes passing stationary copper horns. Discharges 100kA lightning and EMP induced surges from surface antenna feeds to deep earth grounding rods.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Sounds like an artillery battery firing inside a steel locker. Ozone smell will give you a headache in two minutes. But it saved our shortwave receiver when lightning struck the intake tower.

manuals.title: Direct Injection Pintle Nozzle Micro-Lapping & Opening Pressure Calibration
manuals.schematic_summary: Multi-hole spray tip needle valve. Hand hydraulic pop-tester schematic showing opening pressure adjustment shim stack (210 bar). Conical seat lapping using cast iron laps and diamond paste.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: A dribbling diesel injector washes lubrication oil off cylinder walls and burns a hole through the piston crown in 100 operating hours. Pop-test every nozzle until it produces a crisp, dry squeak.

manuals.title: Torque-Transmitter Synchro-Resolver Remote Valve Position Telemetry
manuals.schematic_summary: Single-phase stator with 3-phase star rotor operating at 110V 400Hz AC. Transmits exact rotary blast valve angles across 500m unshielded telephone pairs to the Master Control Room console.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Simple, rugged, beautiful. When the servo motor in Sub-Level 4 turns, the dial in my office mirrors it with zero lag and zero computer chips. Clean the silver slip rings with alcohol.

manuals.title: Regenerative Potassium Superoxide (KO2) CO2 Absorption & Oxygen Release
manuals.origin_facility: Institute of Biomedical Problems (Cosmonaut Life Support)
manuals.schematic_summary: Cylindrical canister filled with porous KO2 briquettes and calcium hydroxide catalyst. Absorbs moisture and carbon dioxide from exhaled breath and releases pure oxygen (1.2 liters O2 per liter CO2 absorbed).
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Vital warning: KO2 reacts with organic grease like solid rocket fuel. Never touch the granules with oily gloves or tools, or you will cause an instant flash fire inside the ventilation duct.

manuals.title: C-Type Bourdon Tube Pressure Gauge Overhaul & Deadweight Tester Calibration
manuals.schematic_summary: Oval-cross-section bronze Bourdon tube linked through sector-and-pinion movement to pointer. Calibration procedure against oil deadweight tester with certified tungsten-carbide weights.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: If our steam pressure gauge lies to us, the boiler becomes a 10-ton shrapnel bomb. I calibrate every gauge against the deadweight tester every six months. No dweller touches the hairspring.

manuals.title: Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) Airborne Fallout Aerosol Mass Monitor
manuals.schematic_summary: 10 MHz AT-cut gold-plated quartz crystal resonator. Frequency shift proportional to nanogram aerosol mass deposited on crystal face by electrostatic precipitator sampler.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Measures invisible radioactive dust grains floating past the air intake before they reach the main filters. Keep the crystal surface free from grease; clean only in ultrasonic alcohol baths.

manuals.title: Single-Stage End-Suction Centrifugal Water Pump Mechanical Seal & Packing Gland
manuals.schematic_summary: Cast iron volute casing with bronze closed impeller. Explains square braided Teflon-graphite packing installation, lantern ring cooling water flush, and gland follower adjustment (10-15 drops/minute leak rate).
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Miners always make the mistake of tightening the packing nuts until the shaft stops leaking entirely. That burns the shaft sleeve in ten minutes. It MUST weep a steady 12 drops a minute to stay cool.

manuals.title: Saturable-Core Reactor & Magnetic Amplifier (Mag-Amp) Generator Voltage Regulator
manuals.origin_facility: Design Bureau of Marine Automation (Bunkers & Submarines)
manuals.schematic_summary: High-permeability Permalloy toroidal cores with AC load windings and DC control windings. Modulates 5kW generator excitation current without electronic vacuum tubes or transistors.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Built like a tank. You can drop it off a mezzanine floor or hit it with a high-voltage surge, and it will still regulate the alternator voltage to within 1%. Pure copper wire and iron cores.

manuals.title: Rapid-Closing Overpressure Blast Attenuation Valve (Discs & Pre-Compress Springs)
manuals.origin_facility: State Design Bureau for Special Protective Structures
manuals.schematic_summary: Heavy stainless steel disc assembly mounted on pre-compressed helical springs inside intake air plenum. Incoming supersonic shock wave forces discs shut against neoprene seats in 6 milliseconds.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: The primary shield between us and a 10-bar atmospheric shock front. Check the neoprene seat rings for cracks every spring. If the rubber hardens from cold drafts, replace with silicone gaskets.

manuals.title: Cold-Blast Foundry Cupola Furnace Silica Refractory Lining & Tuyere Geometry
manuals.schematic_summary: Vertical cylindrical steel furnace lined with 95% silica ganister refractory mortar. Four water-cooled copper blast tuyeres angled 10 degrees downward. Tapping spout, slag dam, and bottom drop-doors.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Master Oleg's Bible for the Silent Foundry. If you get the tuyere angle wrong, the air blast oxidizes the molten iron into unusable crusty slag. Ram the ganister lining tight with wooden rammers.

manuals.title: Selenium Barrier-Layer Photocell Boiler Flame Scanner & Fuel Cutoff Interlock
manuals.schematic_summary: Self-generating selenium photovoltaic cell mounted in air-cooled sighting tube aimed at burner flame. Operates sensitive polarized relay directly without electronic amplifiers to close solenoid fuel valve on flameout.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: If the flame goes out in the boiler and the oil keeps pumping, the firebox fills with atomized fuel mist and the next spark turns the cellar into a bomb. Keep the scanner lens clean of soot.

manuals.title: Kinetic Penetrator Orbital Decay, Atmospheric Re-Entry Perigee & Radar Ephemeris
manuals.origin_facility: Silo 0 Strategic Defense Command / Cosmic Forces Directorate
manuals.schematic_summary: Keplerian orbital orbital decay tables and Doppler radar ranging formulas for unguided 5-ton tungsten carbide kinetic penetrator spears falling from 400km low Earth orbit. Impact ellipse coordinates for Tessarat Valley.
manuals.dmitri_engineering_notes: Recovered from the safe in Silo 0. The mathematics that predict when The Keeper and its orbital harpoons will skim over our valley. With this, we have a 90-second warning before a spear hits the granite ridge.
